items.material: The community library opens a repair table every Sunday morning. People can bring small lamps, bags or toys. Volunteers begin by asking what has gone wrong. They do not promise to fix everything, but they explain what they are trying and why. Visitors are asked to bring an old towel to protect the table during cleaning. Last week, a student learned how to replace a loose button on a bag. She then showed her younger brother what to do. The library hopes the activity will help people use things for longer instead of throwing them away too soon.
